title: Cleopatra, last Hellenistic pharaoh
summary: Cleopatra ruled Ptolemaic Egypt from 51 to 30 BCE and is the only Ptolemaic ruler known to have learned Egyptian. After her death in Alexandria in 30 BCE, Egypt became a Roman province.
why: Her death marks the end of the Hellenistic period.

notes.problem: Source says 'only Ptolemaic ruler known to have learned the Egyptian language', not 'first'.
